title: Cardano Onboarding Campaign at larger crypto events, and multiples local education events.

ms.criteria: This milestone should be accepted given that we provide a mockup of our onboarding process in figma. This figma design must be able to be integrated into our website and provide users with an educational journey about Cardano.
ms.report:
To prove completion of this milestone, here is a mock design showcasing the Atrium onboarding experience for new users. This onboarding experience is a guided web journey which will be built into our site that takes a user from a non Cardano user, and shows them how to safely become an Ada holder with a wallet. 
Our team has designed and easy to use navigation screen for users throughout this onboarding process. Users are greet on the homepage of Atrium.io with the option for guidance. If accepted, users maybe choose whether they are:
・A new user to cryptocurrency, 
・Familiar with cryptocurrency, but a new user to Cardano
・Familiar with Cardano, but a new user to Atrium

These three choices lead to differing paths through our educational content. The former being the most extensive route, the second skips some of the basics and focuses of Cardano specific education, and the later directs straight to Atrium specific education.
A left hand menu is also provided, should a user wish to form their own path through our educational content, and ignore the predetermined route.
We have submitted a link to our Figma file which shows these three routes visualised in the Atrium style, with an example to show how the routes would differ.
https://www.figma.com/file/U6VO4fEqkZqhqSVO6wZUGi/Atrium-MVP?type=design&node-id=29038%3A3715&mode=design&t=TqCJrZLIpE7WOkJU-1
We also have a link to most of our scripts for our portal, to save on recreating essentially the same page design on figma.
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1y42FjXWayWwby3egS4ZZPwlkpglq_qm2_ZnGouv0eoY/edit?usp=sharing
In our view, this delivers on our milestone promise to create a mock design of our onboarding experience, guiding users through Cardano and onboarding them into the ecosystem.

ms.promise:
This milestone will output our first networking event hosted in London. We've partnered with Upstream, they are a Cardano stakepool operator that has built a strong community in London. They've hosted many events already and will help us bring a lot more people to this event. We've decided London is a great place to host an event as there's a lot of strong teams already building Cardano products in or around London. Our co-founder also lives in this area, to help coordinate/review venues.

This event will be hosted in London with a venue that has 80-150 capacity. We will charge $1 to make sure that people that RSVP to the event actually come to event. We've had issues in the past with people taking spots, and not showing.

The goal of this event is to create a place for existing Cardano projects, startups, and regular users to network and talk about the future of Cardano. While their won't be a larger event going on in London at this time, due to the existing amount of Cardano users in London we think this event will suffice as a great way for our community to network. In our later milestones we will host a larger event at Consensus2023, and a local educational event in Florida.
ms.criteria:

We have completed milestone 3, successfully hosting an exciting Cardano filled evening in the Soda Rooms at the Botanist, Broadgate Circus in London.
We partnered with Upstream stake pool to tap into their existing London based network and bring together a warm crowd of like-minded individuals.
Evidence of completion is provided below:
Pictures (we have supplied a video which delivers this more concisely)
Meet up page (incorrectly called 'Medium page' on criteria submission, sincerest apologies)
PDF report
We believe we have more than evidenced our completion of this milestone and look forward to delivering on our previous, and next milestone in due course.

ms.promise:
This milestone will be an educational Cardano event hosted in Florida for new users that have never used blockchain before. We’ll have a complete onboarding experience on our site for all of these new users, and our founder will be there to answer questions and guide users through the education material. All of these users will be given a proof of onboarding cards that they can use to add an NFT, a small amount of ADA, and a Cardano Native token in their wallet.

This milestone will also output the proof of onboarding cards themselves, and take the design from milestone one and integrate it into our website. We'll also output a close-out report video that goes into what we've learned from hosting these events, what attendees found most valuable, any issues that we've overcome, and how we'll improve in the future. This video will also take a look at the educational page that we've created for users.
ms.criteria:
